ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) focal regions; approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular rings and irregular clusters distributed across the medial and central fluke regions; distinct high-intensity linear bands localized on the distal tips of both lobes against a uniform dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; bounding-box depth is significant, dividing the fluke into two distinct lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) and valleys extending from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary outer boundary follows a convex curve from the insertion point toward the distal tips, with a sharp transition to the serrated trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (rosettes) concentrated primarily in the lower-central region of the left lobe and the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5-7 parallel vertical high-contrast lines on the distal left lobe tip; set of 4-6 horizontal/diagonal parallel lines on the distal right lobe tip; scattered singular linear disruptions across the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma characterized by multiple circular barnacle attachment scars and distinct linear rake marks on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and specific spatial arrangement of circular rosette scars creates a unique high-frequency texture across the dark pigment.
